spans.s: विध् vt. 6P (pres. विधति) 1. To cut, to divide; 2. to rule, to govern; 3. to honour, to worship.
विध m. 1. Form, manner, kind, sort; 2. the food of elephants; 3. prosperity; 4. penetration; 5. (at the end of a compound) fold, (e.g. सप्तविध, अष्टविध).
विधा f. 1. Manner, mode; 2. kind, sort; 3. prosperity; 4. the food of elephants; 5. hire, wages; 6. penetration.
विधवन n. Shaking, agitating, trembling.
विधव्य n. Agitation, tremor.
विधवा f. A widow, M.viii.28.
विधवा-आवेदन n. marrying a widow.
विधवा-गामिन् m. one who has sexual intercourse with a widow.
विधस् m. An epithet of Brahman (m.).

विधातृ m. 1. An epithet of Brahman (m.), विधातृसृष्टौ न हि दृष्टपूर्वा Bh.V.i.125, R.vii.25, vi.11, i.85; 2. a maker, a creator, K.S.i.57, vii.36; 3. fate, destiny; 4. spirituous liquor; 5. an epithet of Viśvakarman; 6. of the god of love.
विधातृ-आयुस् m. 1. the sun-flower; 2. sunshine.
विधातृ-भू m. an epithet of Nārada.

विधान n. 1. Arranging, disposing, arrangement; 2. creating, making, forming, R.vii.14; 3. doing, performing, using, R.viii.40; 4. enjoining, prescribing; 5. a rule, a precept, an injunction, a sacred text, Bg.xvi.24, xvii.24; 6. means, expedient; 7. wealth; 8. the food of elephants; 9. pain, sorrow, distress.
विधान-ग, -ज्ञ m. a learned man, a paṇḍit.
विधान-ग, -ज्ञ m. a learned man, a paṇḍit.
विधानक n. Pain, distress, affliction.
विधायक a. (f. यिका) 1. Arranging, disposing; 2. doing, performing; 3. enjoining, inculcating; 4. delivering, consigning.
विधायक a. (f. यिका) 1. Arranging, disposing; 2. doing, performing; 3. enjoining, inculcating; 4. delivering, consigning.

विधि m. 1. An epithet of Brahman (m.); 2. fate, destiny, luck, विधिना वैरिणा रुद्धमार्गः Megh.ii.39; 3. creation, कल्याणी विधिषु विचित्रता विधातुः Kir.vii.7; 4. food for elephants; 5. time; 6. a physician; 7. method, manner, way, means; 8. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 9. a rite, a ceremony, a religious act, संतानार्थाय विधये स्वभुजादवतारिता R.i.34, iii.45; 10. performance, observance, practice, न च योगविधेर्नवेतरः स्थिरधीरापरमात्मदर्शनात् R.viii.22; 11. a sacred precept, a sacred command, a religious injunction or commandment, (op. to अर्थवाद which consists in explanatory statements and illustrations); 12. a commandment, enjoining something for the first time, (op. to नियम and परिसंख्या qq.vv.).
विधि-ज्ञ m. a Brāhmaṇa who is conversant with the ritual, a ritualist.
विधि-दृष्ट a. prescribed by rule.
विधि-द्वैध n. variance of precepts.
विधि-प्रयोग m. the application of a rule.
विधि-वधू f. an epithet of Sarasvatī.
विधि-हीन a. unauthorized, irregular.
विधित्सा f. 1. Desire to do; 2. design, purpose.
विधित्सित n. Design, purpose.
विधु m. 1. The moon, विधुमिव विकटविधुंतुददंतदलनगलितामृतधारम् Git.G.iv., Na.xxii.; 2. camphor; 3. a demon, a fiend; 4. an expiatory oblation; 5. an epithet of Brahman (m.); 6. of Viṣṇu.
विधु-क्षय m. the wane of the moon.
विधुंतुद m. an epithet of Rāhu, विधुमिव विकटविधुंतुददंतदलनगलितामृतधारम् Git.G.iv.
विधु-पिंजर m. a sabre.
विधु-प्रिया f. a lunar mansion.
विधुत a. (f. ता) The same as विधूत q.v.
विधुत a. (f. ता) The same as विधूत q.v.
विधूत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Shaken, tossed about, tremulous; 2. unsteady; 3. dispelled, removed; 4. abandoned, (pp. of धू with वि q.v.).
विधूत (II) n. Repugnance.
विधूत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Shaken, tossed about, tremulous; 2. unsteady; 3. dispelled, removed; 4. abandoned, (pp. of धू with वि q.v.).
विधुति f. Trepidation, tremor, वदनविधुतयः पांतु चीत्कारवत्यः M.M.i.
विधूति f. Agitation, tremor.
विधुनन n. Shaking, agitating.
विधूनन n. Agitation, tremor.

विधुर (I) a. (f. रा) 1. Destitute of, free from, सा वै कलंकविधुरा मधुराननश्रीः Bh.V.ii.5; 2. miserable, distressed; 3. suffering separation from a lover or mistress, प्रसरति शशधरबिम्बे विहितविलम्बे च माधवे विधुरा । विरचितविविधविलापं सा परितापं चकारोच्चैः Git.G.vii., K.S.iv.32; 4. hostile, adverse.
विधुर (II) m. A widower.
विधुर (III) n. 1. Terror, alarm, anxiety; 2. separation from a lover or mistress.

विधुर (I) a. (f. रा) 1. Destitute of, free from, सा वै कलंकविधुरा मधुराननश्रीः Bh.V.ii.5; 2. miserable, distressed; 3. suffering separation from a lover or mistress, प्रसरति शशधरबिम्बे विहितविलम्बे च माधवे विधुरा । विरचितविविधविलापं सा परितापं चकारोच्चैः Git.G.vii., K.S.iv.32; 4. hostile, adverse.
विधुरा f. Curds mixed with sugar and spices.
विधुवन n. Shaking, trembling, tremor.
विधृत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Seized, grasped; 2. separated, kept off; 3. assumed, possessed; 4. preserved; 5. restrained, withheld, (pp. of धृ with वि q.v.).
विधृत (II) n. Dissatisfaction, disregard of a command.
विधृत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Seized, grasped; 2. separated, kept off; 3. assumed, possessed; 4. preserved; 5. restrained, withheld, (pp. of धृ with वि q.v.).

विधेय (I) a. (f. या) 1. To be prescribed or enjoined, (as a rule or precept); 2. to be predicated; 3. to be performed or done; 4. controlled, governable, subject to, विधेयात्मा प्रसादमधिगच्छति Bg.ii.64, स्त्रीविधयनवयौवनोऽभवत् R.xix.4; 5. obedient, tractable, Kir.xi.33.
विधेय (II) m. A servant.
विधेय (III) n. The predicate of a sentence, (op. to उद्देश्य q.v.).

विधेय (I) a. (f. या) 1. To be prescribed or enjoined, (as a rule or precept); 2. to be predicated; 3. to be performed or done; 4. controlled, governable, subject to, विधेयात्मा प्रसादमधिगच्छति Bg.ii.64, स्त्रीविधयनवयौवनोऽभवत् R.xix.4; 5. obedient, tractable, Kir.xi.33.
विधेय-अविमर्श m. imperfect or inadequate expression of the predicate, giving a subordinate position to the predicate, (considered as a fault of composition).
विधेय-ज्ञ a. one who knows his duty.
विधेय-पद n. an object to be accomplished.
विध्वंस m. 1. Ruin, destruction; 2. insult, offence; 3. enmity.
विध्वस्त a. (f. स्ता) 1. Ruined, destroyed; 2. obscured, darkened; 3. tossed up.
विध्वस्त a. (f. स्ता) 1. Ruined, destroyed; 2. obscured, darkened; 3. tossed up.
वीध्र (I) a. (f. ध्रा) Clear, clean.
वीध्र (II) n. 1. The sky; 2. wind; 3. fire.
वीध्र (I) a. (f. ध्रा) Clear, clean.
